label: HTML
headline: HTML Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for HTML elements and attributes — from document structure and text formatting to forms, tables, media, and semantic layout.

items.name: <!DOCTYPE>
items.definition: Must be the very first line — tells the browser this is an HTML5 document.

items.name: <html>
items.definition: Root element that wraps all page content. Set lang for accessibility and SEO.

items.name: <head>
items.definition: Contains metadata, title, styles, and scripts — nothing visible on the page.

items.name: <body>
items.definition: Contains all visible page content.

items.name: <title>
items.definition: Sets the text shown in the browser tab and used by search engines.

items.name: <meta charset>
items.definition: Declares character encoding. UTF-8 supports all languages and symbols.

items.name: <meta viewport>
items.definition: Makes the page scale correctly on mobile devices.
HTML comment — not displayed in the browser, useful for notes in your code.
Defines a paragraph. Browsers add space above and below.
Line break — moves content to the next line without starting a new paragraph.

items.name: <hr>
items.definition: Horizontal rule — draws a thematic dividing line across the page.

items.name: <strong>
items.definition: Bold text with semantic importance — screen readers emphasise it.

items.name: <b>
items.definition: Bold text for stylistic purposes only, no semantic meaning.

items.name: <em>
items.definition: Italic text with semantic emphasis — screen readers stress it.

items.name: <i>
items.definition: Italic text for stylistic purposes — used for technical terms, foreign words.

items.name: <u>
items.definition: Underline text. Avoid for links — users may confuse it with a hyperlink.

items.name: <mark>
items.definition: Highlight text as if with a marker pen — yellow background by default.

items.name: <del>
items.definition: Strikethrough text representing removed content.

items.name: <ins>
items.definition: Underlined text representing newly added content.

items.name: <small>
items.definition: Renders text smaller — used for disclaimers, copyright, side comments.

items.name: <sup>
items.definition: Superscript text — raised above the baseline. Used for exponents and footnotes.

items.name: <sub>
items.definition: Subscript text — lowered below the baseline. Used in chemical formulas.

items.name: <code>
items.definition: Inline code snippet — displayed in monospace font.

items.name: <pre>
items.definition: Preformatted text — preserves all whitespace and line breaks exactly as written.

items.name: <kbd>
items.definition: Represents keyboard input — usually styled like a key cap.

items.name: <blockquote>
items.definition: Block-level quotation — indented by default. Use cite attribute for the source URL.

items.name: <h1>
items.definition: Top-level heading. Use only once per page — critical for SEO and accessibility.

items.name: <h2>
items.definition: Second-level heading for major sections.

items.name: <h3>
items.definition: Third-level heading for subsections within an h2 section.

items.name: <h4> – <h6>
items.definition: Fourth through sixth level headings. Use hierarchy in order — don't skip levels.

items.name: <a>
items.definition: Hyperlink — navigates to another page, section, file, or resource.

items.name: target="_blank"
items.definition: Open the link in a new browser tab. Add rel="noopener" for security.

items.name: Email link
items.definition: Opens the user's default email client with the address pre-filled.

items.name: Phone link
items.definition: Dials the number on mobile devices when tapped.

items.name: Anchor link
items.definition: Scrolls to an element on the same page with the matching id.

items.name: rel="noopener"
items.definition: Prevents the new tab from accessing the opener page — important for security.
Embeds an image. Always include alt text for accessibility.

items.name: loading="lazy"
items.definition: Defer loading the image until it's near the viewport — improves page speed.

items.name: <figure>
items.definition: Wraps an image with an optional caption. Semantically links the image and its description.

items.name: <picture>
items.definition: Serves different image formats or sizes based on the browser and screen.

items.name: <video>
items.definition: Embeds a video. The controls attribute shows play/pause/volume UI.

items.name: <audio>
items.definition: Embeds an audio player. Add controls to show the browser's default UI.

items.name: <iframe>
items.definition: Embeds another web page inside the current one. Always include a title.

items.name: <canvas>
items.definition: A blank drawing surface — graphics are rendered onto it using JavaScript.

items.name: <div>
items.definition: Generic block-level container with no semantic meaning. Used for layout and styling.

items.name: <span>
items.definition: Generic inline container with no semantic meaning. Used to style part of a text.

items.name: <header>
items.definition: Page or section header — typically contains logo, nav, or introductory content.

items.name: <nav>
items.definition: Navigation links section — helps screen readers and search engines find the menu.

items.name: <main>
items.definition: The primary unique content of the page. Only one per page.

items.name: <article>
items.definition: Self-contained content that could stand alone — blog post, news article, comment.

items.name: <section>
items.definition: Thematic grouping of content, usually with a heading.

items.name: <aside>
items.definition: Supplementary content tangentially related to the main content — sidebars, callouts.

items.name: <footer>
items.definition: Page or section footer — typically contains copyright, links, or contact info.

items.name: <details>
items.definition: Native accordion/disclosure widget. Content is hidden until the user clicks the summary.

items.name: <table>
items.definition: Defines a data table. Use only for tabular data, not for layout.

items.name: <thead>
items.definition: Groups the header row(s) of the table. Repeated when printing on multiple pages.

items.name: <tbody>
items.definition: Groups the body rows of the table — the main data.

items.name: <tfoot>
items.definition: Groups footer rows — totals, summaries. Rendered last but declared after thead.

items.name: <tr>
items.definition: Defines a table row.

items.name: <th>
items.definition: Header cell — bold and centred by default. Use scope="col" or scope="row".

items.name: <td>
items.definition: Standard data cell.

items.name: colspan
items.definition: Makes a cell span across multiple columns.

items.name: rowspan
items.definition: Makes a cell span across multiple rows.

items.name: <caption>
items.definition: Provides a title for the table — important for accessibility.

items.name: <ul>
items.definition: Unordered (bulleted) list — for items with no meaningful sequence.

items.name: <ol>
items.definition: Ordered (numbered) list — for items where sequence matters.

items.name: <li>
items.definition: A single item inside a ul or ol. Can contain nested lists.

items.name: <dl>
items.definition: Definition list — pairs of terms and their descriptions. Good for glossaries and FAQs.

items.name: <dt>
items.definition: The term being defined in a description list.

items.name: <dd>
items.definition: The description or definition of the preceding dt term.

items.name: <form>
items.definition: Container for form controls. method is GET or POST; action is the server endpoint.

items.name: <label>
items.definition: Associates a text label with a form control. Clicking the label focuses the input.

items.name: <input>
items.definition: The most versatile form element — behaviour changes entirely with the type attribute.

items.name: <textarea>
items.definition: Multi-line text input. Set rows and cols or use CSS for sizing.

items.name: <select>
items.definition: Dropdown selection list. Use multiple attribute to allow multiple selections.

items.name: <option>
items.definition: A selectable item inside a select element. value is what gets submitted.

items.name: <button>
items.definition: Clickable button. type can be submit (default), reset, or button.

items.name: <fieldset>
items.definition: Groups related form fields with an optional border and legend caption.

items.name: <datalist>
items.definition: Provides autocomplete suggestions for a text input without restricting values.

items.name: text
items.definition: Single-line text field — the default input type.

items.name: password
items.definition: Masked text field — characters are hidden as the user types.

items.name: email
items.definition: Email address field — validates format and shows email keyboard on mobile.

items.name: number
items.definition: Numeric input with optional min, max, and step constraints.

items.name: tel
items.definition: Phone number field — shows numeric keyboard on mobile.

items.name: url
items.definition: URL input — validates format and shows URL keyboard on mobile.

items.name: search
items.definition: Search field — may show a clear button and uses search keyboard on mobile.

items.name: checkbox
items.definition: Tick box — allows multiple selections from a group.

items.name: radio
items.definition: Radio button — only one option in a group (same name) can be selected.

items.name: range
items.definition: Slider for selecting a value within a range.

items.name: color
items.definition: Color picker that returns a hex value.

items.name: date
items.definition: Date picker — returns a yyyy-mm-dd value.

items.name: time
items.definition: Time picker — returns an hh:mm value.

items.name: datetime-local
items.definition: Combined date and time picker.

items.name: file
items.definition: File upload control. Use accept to restrict allowed file types.

items.name: hidden
items.definition: Invisible field that submits a value — used for CSRF tokens and tracking.

items.name: submit
items.definition: Button that submits the form.

items.name: reset
items.definition: Button that resets all form fields to their default values.

items.name: placeholder
items.definition: Hint text shown inside the input when it is empty.

items.name: required
items.definition: Form cannot be submitted until this field has a value.

items.name: disabled
items.definition: Prevents user interaction — the field's value is not submitted.

items.name: readonly
items.definition: User cannot edit the value, but it is still submitted with the form.

items.name: autofocus
items.definition: Automatically focuses this field when the page loads.

items.name: autocomplete
items.definition: Controls whether the browser offers to fill in the field automatically.

items.name: minlength / maxlength
items.definition: Minimum and maximum number of characters allowed in a text field.

items.name: min / max
items.definition: Minimum and maximum values for number, range, or date inputs.

items.name: step
items.definition: The increment for number and range inputs.

items.name: pattern
items.definition: Regular expression the value must match for the form to submit.

items.name: multiple
items.definition: Allows the user to select multiple files (file input) or options (select).

items.name: checked
items.definition: Pre-selects a checkbox or radio button when the page loads.

items.name: <script> inline
items.definition: Embeds JavaScript directly in the HTML document.

items.name: <script> external
items.definition: Loads an external JS file. defer runs the script after the HTML is parsed.

items.name: <style>
items.definition: Embeds CSS styles directly in the document — best placed in <head>.

items.name: <link> stylesheet
items.definition: Links an external CSS file — the standard way to add styles to a page.

items.name: <link> favicon
items.definition: Sets the favicon shown in the browser tab.

items.name: defer
items.definition: Script runs after the HTML is fully parsed — keeps the page fast.

items.name: async
items.definition: Script downloads in parallel and runs as soon as it's ready, without waiting for parsing.

items.name: description
items.definition: Short description of the page shown in search engine results.

items.name: canonical
items.definition: Tells search engines the preferred URL for this page — avoids duplicate content.

items.name: robots
items.definition: Instructs search engine crawlers whether to index and follow links on this page.

items.name: og:title
items.definition: Title shown when the page is shared on social media (Open Graph).

items.name: og:description
items.definition: Description shown in social media previews.

items.name: og:image
items.definition: Image shown when the page is shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.

items.name: og:url
items.definition: Canonical URL for social sharing.

items.name: twitter:card
items.definition: Controls how the page appears when shared on Twitter/X.

items.name: twitter:image
items.definition: Image shown in Twitter/X card previews.
